item.statement: The candidate must surface launch and execution errors host-side and must not use odata as an in-band status channel; the kernel itself has no status return.

plans.objective: Verify the error-status model of the future candidate.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the entry point and host error paths.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff kernel-side failures are host-observable, the kernel returns no direct status, and no odata element encodes status.
plans.setup: Inspect the candidate kernel return type, host wrapper return/error propagation, and any odata status convention.
